visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Euclid Instead of Trying Every Divisor
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop tests every number up to the smaller value. Replace it with Euclid's algorithm. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Euclid's algorithm needs only a handful of steps even for huge numbers, because each step at least halves one of them. Trying every divisor needs as many steps as the smaller number.
